howto.what: 这个技能让Claude成为.NET 8后端专家，能帮你用最小API、整洁架构或云原生微服务构建应用，并处理Entity Framework Core、CQRS、JWT认证等任务。
howto.when: 当你提到“.NET Core”、“.NET 8”、“ASP.NET Core”、“C# 12”、“最小API”、“Entity Framework Core”、“微服务 .NET”、“CQRS”、“MediatR”等关键词，或要求构建相关后端功能时触发。

say.text: 帮我用最小API创建一个用户查询端点。
say.note: Claude会生成代码并解释架构。
Claude会添加认证中间件和策略。

say.text: 用CQRS和MediatR实现一个命令处理器。
say.note: Claude会创建查询/命令和处理器。

howto.what_en: This skill turns Claude into a .NET 8 backend expert, helping you build applications with minimal APIs, clean architecture, or cloud-native microservices, and handle Entity Framework Core, CQRS, JWT authentication, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like ".NET Core", ".NET 8", "ASP.NET Core", "C# 12", "minimal API", "Entity Framework Core", "microservices .NET", "CQRS", "MediatR", or ask to build related backend features.

say_en.text: Help me create a user query endpoint using minimal API.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code and explain the architecture.

say_en.text: Configure JWT authentication for my .NET 8 project.
say_en.note: Claude will add auth middleware and policies.

say_en.text: Implement a command handler with CQRS and MediatR.
say_en.note: Claude will create query/command and handler.
